driver_source:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""One-off matched backend experiment using the standard suite's host and gate."""
import argparse
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import platform
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.cwd()
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('standard_suite', ROOT/'bench/wasm_tier.py')
wt = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(wt)
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--revision', required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
virt = subprocess.run(['systemd-detect-virt'], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert platform.node().split('.')[0].lower() == 'alpha'
assert virt.returncode == 1 and virt.stdout.strip() == 'none'
assert wt.base.git('rev-parse', 'HEAD') == args.revision
assert not wt.base.git('status', '--porcelain', '--', 'cmd', 'std', 'include', 'bootstrap', 'Makefile')
os.environ['ZIRAN_LEARN'] = 'off'
work = ROOT/'build/native-ab'
bundles = {'before': work/'before/suite.zx', 'after': work/'sqrt/suite.zx'}
artifacts = {
    'c': work/'before/c-single',
    'before': work/'after/native-single',
    'after': work/'sqrt/native-single',
}
prior = json.loads((ROOT/'bench/results/standard/native-constant-divide-alpha.json').read_text())
assert wt.standard_sha(artifacts['before']) == prior['artifacts']['after']
assert wt.standard_sha(artifacts['c']) == prior['artifacts']['c']
assert wt.standard_sha(bundles['before']) == prior['bundle_sha256']
env = wt.HostGate.environment()
gate = wt.HostGate()

def run(command):
    return json.loads(wt.platforms.run(command, env=env, timeout=3600))

def single_measurement(command, expected):
    result = run(command)
    assert result["result"] == expected
    assert len(result["batch_samples_ms"]) == 1 and result["batch_samples_ms"][0] > 0
    return result

def command(target, kind, size, expected):
    return [artifacts[target], '-' if target == 'c' else bundles[target], kind, size, 1, expected]

receipt = {
    'schema_version': 1, 'host': platform.node(), 'cpu': wt.base.cpu_name(),
    'virtualization': 'none', 'learning': 'off', 'checks': False,
    'before_revision': '426c7329289c548537cb7f1f73d7727f5183a907',
    'before_evidence': 'bench/results/standard/native-constant-divide-alpha.json',
    'after_revision': args.revision,
    'measured_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'samples': 11, 'host_gate': gate.describe(),
    'methodology': 'Standard workload and host; baseline uses the preserved pre-sqrt suite.zx, after uses the same unchanged kernels with std/math hardware sqrt regenerated by the pushed compiler. Baseline includes constant division fix; after also includes the published bank-specific verifier and restored comparison-folding fixes. Private host copy changes only samples!=11 to (samples<1||samples>11), allowing one timed call per process. Each process warms 150 ms. Eleven rounds alternate C/before/after and after/before/C on one pinned core, with every checksum verified. Startup and loading excluded. Symmetric 1.5xIQR inclusive interpolated quartiles; raw samples, excluded indices and host-gate rejection attempts retained.',
    'artifacts': {name: wt.standard_sha(path) for name, path in artifacts.items()},
    'bundle_sha256': {name: wt.standard_sha(path) for name,path in bundles.items()},
    'build_commands': (ROOT/'backup/native-sqrt-alpha.sh').read_text(),
    'tool_sha256': {name: wt.standard_sha(work/'sqrt-tools/bin'/name) for name in ('zi2c','zi2zx','zx2native')},
    'runtime_sha256': wt.standard_sha(work/'sqrt-tools/libziran.a'),
    'workload_source_sha256': {str(path.relative_to(ROOT)): wt.standard_sha(path) for path in sorted((ROOT/'bench/standard').iterdir()) if path.is_file()},
    'host_source_sha256': wt.standard_sha(work/'host.c'),
    'standard_host_source_sha256': wt.standard_sha(ROOT/'bench/standard/host.c'),
    'driver_source': Path(__file__).read_text(),
    'examples': [],
}
for kind in (1, 2, 8, 0, 3):
    name, size, probe = wt.STANDARD_CASES[kind]
    expected = run(command('c', kind, size, 'oracle'))['result']
    probe_expected = run(command('c', kind, probe, 'oracle'))['result']
    for target in ('before', 'after'):
        checked = run(command(target, kind, probe, probe_expected))
        assert checked['result'] == probe_expected
    runs = {name: [] for name in artifacts}
    for round_index in range(11):
        order = ('c', 'before', 'after') if round_index % 2 == 0 else ('after', 'before', 'c')
        for target in order:
            cmd = command(target, kind, size, expected)
            measured = gate.measure(lambda: single_measurement(cmd, expected))
            assert len(measured['batch_samples_ms']) == 1
            measured['command'] = wt.base.command_text(cmd)
            runs[target].append(measured)
    targets = {}
    for target, measured in runs.items():
        summary = wt.platforms.summarize({'result': expected, 'batches': 1,
            'batch_samples_ms': [row['batch_samples_ms'][0] for row in measured]}, expected)
        summary['runs'] = measured
        targets[target] = summary
    receipt['examples'].append({'id': name, 'input': size, 'expected': expected,
        'probe_input': probe, 'probe_expected': probe_expected, 'targets': targets})
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2)+'\n')
    print(name, *(f'{targets[t]["execution_ms"]*1000:.3f}' for t in ('c','before','after')), flush=True)
